title: Wi-Fi disconnects frequently
solution: Forget and reconnect to the Wi-Fi network; restart the wireless adapter; update the Wi-Fi driver; test closer to the access point.

title: No internet connection
problem: Connected to network but cannot browse
solution: Check whether other devices have internet; renew the IP configuration; verify DNS settings; restart the router only if you control it.

title: VPN connection fails
problem: Remote access VPN does not connect
solution: Confirm normal internet access first; verify date/time; restart the VPN client; re-enter credentials; capture the exact VPN error code.

title: Slow network performance
problem: Websites and downloads are unusually slow
solution: Run a speed test; pause large downloads; check signal strength; compare wired versus wireless performance.

title: Ethernet has no connection
solution: Reseat the cable; try another port/cable; confirm the adapter is enabled; renew the IP address.

title: DNS resolution problem
problem: Sites fail by name but network is connected
solution: Try reaching a known IP address; flush the DNS cache; switch to the approved DNS servers; restart the network adapter.

title: Cannot reach internal service
problem: Public internet works but internal site fails
solution: Confirm VPN or office network connection; verify the URL; test another internal service; collect traceroute information for IT.

title: Weak Wi-Fi signal
problem: Wireless signal drops in one location
solution: Move closer to the access point; avoid physical obstructions; test another approved access point; compare with another device.

title: Cannot get IP address
problem: Device shows self-assigned or missing IP
solution: Disable/enable the adapter; renew DHCP; reconnect to the network; check whether the issue affects other devices.

title: Network printer unreachable
problem: Printer cannot be reached over network
solution: Confirm the printer is powered on; ping its address; reconnect the printer queue; verify you are on the correct network.

title: Laptop does not power on
problem: No lights or response when pressing power
solution: Disconnect accessories; connect the charger; hold the power button for 15 seconds; retry; note any lights or beep codes.

title: Battery not charging
problem: Laptop battery percentage does not increase
solution: Check charger seating; inspect the cable; try an approved charger; restart; review battery health in the operating system.

title: External monitor not detected
solution: Reseat the display cable; select the correct monitor input; press Detect displays; try another cable or port.

title: Keyboard keys not responding
problem: Some or all keyboard input fails
solution: Restart the device; test an external keyboard; check for stuck keys; update keyboard drivers if required.

title: Mouse disconnects
problem: USB or Bluetooth mouse is intermittent
solution: Replace/recharge the battery; reconnect Bluetooth or USB; try another port; test the mouse on another device.

title: Laptop overheating
problem: Device becomes very hot or shuts down
solution: Move the device to a hard surface; close heavy applications; confirm vents are clear; report repeated thermal shutdowns.

title: USB device not recognised
problem: Computer does not detect USB accessory
solution: Reconnect the device; try another USB port; restart; check Device Manager; test the accessory on another computer.

title: Webcam not detected
solution: Check privacy permissions; close other camera apps; reconnect external webcams; restart the device; test the built-in Camera app.

title: Docking station problems
solution: Power-cycle the dock; reconnect USB-C; test direct connections; update approved dock firmware if available.

title: Unexpected shutdowns
solution: Check overheating; disconnect unnecessary peripherals; review battery/charger behaviour; record when the shutdown happens.

title: Application crashes on launch
solution: Restart the device; check for updates; clear the application cache if supported; repair or reinstall only with approved procedures.

title: Outlook will not open
solution: Restart Outlook; try safe mode; check for Office updates; create a new Outlook profile if approved.

title: Software installation fails
solution: Record the exact error; confirm disk space; run the approved installer; verify you have required permissions.

title: Excel freezes
solution: Open Excel without add-ins; try a local copy of the file; update Office; test another workbook.

title: Teams crashes
solution: Quit Teams fully; clear its cache using approved steps; update the app; restart the device.

title: Browser crashes
solution: Update the browser; disable problematic extensions; clear cache; test an InPrivate/Incognito window.

title: Application update stuck
solution: Restart the application and device; verify internet access and free space; retry the approved update.

title: Missing DLL error
problem: Windows program reports a missing component
solution: Capture the DLL name; repair the application; install the approved runtime package; avoid downloading DLL files from random websites.

title: Software licence issue
problem: Application says licence is missing or expired
solution: Confirm you are signed in with the licensed account; check network access; sign out/in; contact licensing support if entitlement is missing.

title: Cannot save file
solution: Try Save As to an approved local folder; check free space; verify folder permissions; test with a new file.

title: Forgotten password
solution: Use the official password-reset portal; create a strong new password; sign in again; update saved credentials on other devices.

title: Account locked
problem: Too many sign-in attempts locked the account
solution: Wait for the lockout period if policy allows; use self-service unlock; contact the service desk if the account remains locked.

title: Password reset not accepted
solution: Confirm the username; wait briefly for synchronisation; reconnect to network/VPN if required; remove old saved credentials.

title: MFA code not working
solution: Check device time; request a fresh code; verify the correct account in the authenticator; use an approved backup method.

title: Account disabled
solution: Confirm employment/access status; service desk should verify identity and account state before re-enabling.

title: Cannot access work account
solution: Check username format; confirm network; reset password if necessary; capture the exact error message.

title: Password reset link expired
problem: Self-service reset link no longer works
solution: Start a new password-reset request from the official portal and use the newest link only.

title: Authenticator lost after phone change
solution: Use approved recovery methods; service desk should verify identity before resetting MFA registration.

title: Sign-in loop
problem: Login repeatedly returns to sign-in page
solution: Clear site cookies for the service; try a private window; verify system time; sign out of other sessions.

title: Username not recognised
solution: Verify the exact username/email format; check spelling; confirm the account has been provisioned.

title: Cannot send email
solution: Check internet access; inspect Outbox; restart Outlook; verify mailbox quota; note any non-delivery message.

title: Not receiving email
solution: Check webmail; refresh/sync; review rules and junk folder; confirm mailbox quota.

title: Mailbox full
solution: Delete or archive approved messages; empty Deleted Items; review large attachments; request quota help if needed.

title: Attachment will not download
problem: Email file attachment cannot be opened
solution: Check internet access; try webmail; save the file locally; verify security policy has not blocked the attachment.

title: Outlook search broken
solution: Restart Outlook; update Office; rebuild search index only if approved; compare search in webmail.

title: Shared mailbox missing
solution: Confirm permission exists; restart Outlook; remove/re-add the mailbox profile if approved; allow time for permission propagation.

title: Calendar invites missing
solution: Check Deleted/Junk; inspect inbox rules; compare webmail calendar; verify delegate settings.

title: Emails stuck in Outbox
solution: Check connectivity; open large attachments; restart Outlook; move stuck message to Drafts and resend.

title: Email not syncing on phone
problem: Mobile mail is out of date
solution: Confirm internet access; refresh the account; check modern authentication; remove/re-add account only if allowed.

title: Automatic replies fail
problem: Out of office setting does not work
solution: Check start/end dates; configure in webmail; verify inbox rules are not conflicting.

title: Phishing email received
solution: Do not click links or open attachments; report the message using the approved phishing process; delete it after reporting.

title: Phishing link clicked
solution: Disconnect from sensitive sessions; change password from a trusted device; report immediately; review sign-in activity and MFA.

title: Unexpected sign-in alert
solution: Do not approve unknown MFA prompts; change password; revoke suspicious sessions; report the alert to security.

title: Possible malware
solution: Disconnect from network if active compromise is suspected; do not continue normal work; run the approved security scan; contact IT/security.

title: Ransomware warning
problem: Files encrypted or ransom note displayed
solution: Immediately disconnect the device from network and power sources only if instructed; contact security/service desk urgently; do not pay or interact with the ransom note.

title: Lost company device
solution: Report the loss immediately; provide last known location/time; security should revoke sessions and initiate remote protection if available.

title: Password compromised
solution: Change the password from a trusted device; enable/verify MFA; revoke active sessions; report possible exposure.

title: Antivirus detected threat
solution: Do not ignore or disable protection; isolate the device if instructed; capture the alert name; contact IT/security.

title: Unknown MFA prompt
solution: Deny the request; change password; report it; review recent sign-in activity.

title: Sensitive data sent incorrectly
problem: Confidential information went to wrong recipient
solution: Do not send follow-up copies; notify security/privacy immediately; provide recipient, data type and time sent.

title: New desk setup
solution: Connect approved equipment; verify power, display, network and peripherals; record any missing assets.

title: Software access request
problem: User needs access to an application
solution: Use the approved access-request process; include business justification and manager approval where required.

title: Printer setup
solution: Confirm printer name/location; add the approved printer queue; print a test page.

title: Meeting room display help
problem: User needs help presenting in a room
solution: Select the correct room input; connect the approved cable/wireless display; test audio and video before the meeting.

title: New user setup
problem: Prepare access for a new employee
solution: Follow onboarding checklist for account, device, MFA, email, required groups and software.

title: Remote work setup
solution: Confirm internet, VPN, MFA and approved collaboration tools; provide secure remote-working guidance.

title: Shared folder access
problem: User needs help connecting a shared location
solution: Confirm permission; connect using the approved path; re-authenticate if required.

title: Default browser change
problem: User wants a different approved browser
solution: Use operating-system default-app settings and select an approved browser.

title: Approved software install request
solution: Confirm the software is approved and licensed; use managed software centre or service desk process.

title: General IT assistance
problem: Issue does not fit another category
solution: Collect device, symptoms, timing and impact; create a ticket and route to the appropriate support team.
